deepseek-harness-acp is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eb91d1d6339a28e759a8.html
